description: This file implements the main FastAPI application for the API Gateway. It includes endpoints for health checks, OAuth2 token issuance, user info, generic proxying to backend services, and an API composition endpoint. It also sets up necessary middleware such as CORS, security schemes, and includes dependencies for authentication and rate limiting.

methods.description: OAuth2 token issuance endpoint; issues JWT tokens based on credentials.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] me(subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Returns current user info based on bearer token, including subject and claims.

methods.name: generic_proxy( request: Request, full_path: str, subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), )
methods.description: Proxies requests to backend services, forwarding headers and query parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] composed_overview(subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject))
methods.description: Aggregates account data and recent transactions from backend services into one response.
